_doc: World frame: meters, origin = center of the auditorium semicircle, +x east, +y north (stage north). Pixel coords refer to figures/plans/page_N.png rendered at 200 DPI (1700x2200 px, page rotation applied). Transform: [x_m, y_m] = m_per_px * R @ [px - origin_px[0], py - origin_px[1]]. rotation_deg = angle of the image +px axis measured CCW from world +x (east).

page_3.derivation: Origin: mirror-symmetry axis (x=807) + center maximizing sharpness of the radial histogram of the corridor/loge arcs (y=854). Scale: 6 concentric loge riser arcs at r=227..323 px, pitch 18.5 px, matched to the loge row pitch on page_5 (49.3 px x 0.0178 = 0.878 m); first loge arc 227 px <-> 10.73 m on page_5. Cross-check: box-seat side walls 641 px apart -> 30.3 m vs 29.6 m on page_5 (2%).

page_4.derivation: Origin as for page_3. Scale: balcony arcs at r=391/394/419/442 px matched to balcony seating-chart arcs on page_6 at 701/709/750/795 px x 0.0197 m (four independent ratios all give 0.0353-0.0354). Cross-check: exterior colonnade ring is 1.32x larger in px than on page_3 -> 0.0358 (1.4%).

page_5.derivation: Page is rotated: stage (north) at image left, assumed east = image up. CL dash line at py=1143 (also mirror axis). Center px=759 maximizes concentricity of loge rows AA-EE. Scale: box rows of 8 chairs (4x21in + 4x20in = 164 in = 4.166 m) span 234 px. Dimension strings equal chair widths + 4 in (14'-0" = 164+4 in; 27'-0" = 16x20+4 in), so chair sums are used rather than the strings.

page_6.derivation: Rotated like page_5. CL at py=971; center px=653 maximizes concentricity of balcony rows AAA-CCC. Scale: straight row 1 = 12x21in + 9x20in = 432 in = 10.97 m over 558 px (dimension 36'-4" = 432+4 in).
